values.description: rank-biserial with CI, n, z and display Holm p, matched pair 1
values.definition: ONE ROW of the matched-pair table: rank-biserial with its 95% CI, n_paired (instances where BOTH members have a usable value), the Wilcoxon z, and the display-safe Holm p.
